components.description: Types for the portal plugin contract. A plugin imports this package name and gets the RUNTIME over Module Federation -- the host exposes it, and a plugin names this package as its remote key. The package itself ships types only. Deliberately ships no JavaScript for the SDK surface itself — see README.
